scientific_integrity: An explicit mapping-cone proof and a standalone exact finite chain checker are provided; modular tests do not by themselves prove integral homotopy type.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified six-cycle orbit space is classified; no all-order claim. Equivalently formulated but unindexed literature may exist.
title: The six-cycle quotient of the type-\(A_5\) Coxeter sphere is a Moore space
